scope: Targeted comparison of the five incoming archives, their main mathematical spines and future-work sections; not a certification of every delivered claim.
novelty_policy: Classical Fourier, Gamma, and Hurwitz identities are credited. The new report proves the stated extensions relative to the supplied material without asserting global historical priority.

archives.overlap: Ordinary translated Gamma and Hurwitz-jet correlations supply background; the present six-cone formula extends their number of factors.
archives.exclusion: No repetition or improvement of uniform resonance estimates, Herglotz asymptotics, inequalities, or nonseparable formal-module results.

questions_now_answered.answer: All three-factor separated Hurwitz and Stieltjes jet integrals have an explicit six-cone colored Tornheim formula, including rational root-of-unity shifts.
questions_now_answered.remaining: Character decomposition, minimal formal constant spaces, and arithmetic independence are not established.

archives.overlap: Its shifted bilinear spectral kernel, canonical finite part, all-index closure, and unit-scale contact terms are retained as established background and rederived compactly where needed.
archives.exclusion: No claim to solve the S6/S8 reductions, collision renormalization, or conversion of primitive coordinates into a Barnes multiple-Gamma basis.

questions_now_answered.anchor: sections.tex:776-777, Three shifted factors and genuine higher depth
questions_now_answered.answer: A precise entire colored Tornheim coordinate class suffices at every Stieltjes index. The report gives the full local subtraction formula and an explicit three-digamma specialization.

questions_now_answered.anchor: sections.tex:782-783, Dilation, traces, and subtraction-scale dependence
questions_now_answered.answer: The universal harmonic contact polynomial gives the exact dilation/extension/derivative commutator and the compatible transfer-operator distribution identity.

archives.overlap: The periodic R_alpha semigroup, one-generator Stieltjes convolution algebra, unit-scale derivative anomaly, and ordinary integrated correlations are existing input, not new claims here.
archives.exclusion: Nonintegral twists, collision commutators, arithmetic independence, and universal formalization interfaces remain outside the new results.

questions_now_answered.anchor: article.tex:1117-1126, Affine arguments and the boundary of depth-one reduction
questions_now_answered.answer: Every pair has a one-dimensional frequency lattice and reduces to the unit-frequency shifted kernel with factors Q^(s-1)P^(t-1); every local finite-part scale correction is explicit.
questions_now_answered.remaining: Three or more affine frequencies, nonintegral frequencies, and general intermediate pointwise products are not classified.

correction_anchor.finding: A change of one integer affine frequency does not by itself create multiple independent summation indices in a bilinear integral.
correction_anchor.reason: For p=dP and q=dQ with gcd(P,Q)=1, pn+qm=0 has exactly the parametrization (n,m)=(Qr,-Pr).
correction_anchor.replacement: Two periodic factors with positive integer affine frequencies retain a one-dimensional frequency constraint. Their shifted reduction and fixed-coordinate finite parts are given by the integer-dilation theorem. Three or more independent factors generally leave a higher-dimensional frequency lattice.
correction_anchor.effect: No central convolution theorem is invalidated.

archives.overlap: Its bilinear Gamma-ratio linear closure, missing-order rule, explicit J_mn formulas, and ordinary log-Gamma autocorrelation are established background.
archives.exclusion: The present report does not redo coincident-endpoint closure or collision expansions, claim arithmetic independence, or resolve arbitrary successive-renormalization compatibility.

questions_now_answered.anchor: article.tex:1237-1245, A trilinear analogue and its genuine new coordinates
questions_now_answered.answer: Explicit six colored Tornheim kernels and a finite all-index coefficient rule describe every separated triple finite part.
The reduced-frequency theorem and exact local scale terms give the requested finite distribution formula for arbitrary positive integer dilations.

archives.overlap: Its bilinear finite-part closure, periodic convolution algebra, contact terms, and negative-integer primitive ladders overlap the other four archives and serve as background.
archives.exclusion: No new claims on convexity, inequalities, growing-index cusp estimates, Hankel asymptotics, S6/S8 certificates, or coincident higher log-Gamma moments.

questions_now_answered.answer: The requested three-factor subtraction formula and explicit colored Tornheim generating function are proved.
questions_now_answered.remaining: Four or more factors and coalescing shifts remain open here.

questions_now_answered.answer: Positive integer rescaling and affine translation have a complete fixed-coordinate contact law, including all Stieltjes and derivative indices.
questions_now_answered.remaining: General nonlinear changes of local coordinate and arbitrary period changes are not classified.

existing_mixed_endpoint_split.label: cycloquot:eq:harmonic-split
existing_mixed_endpoint_split.warning: The alternating odd-denominator harmonic sum is not the single Gaussian double g_{p,1}.

equivalent_alternative_basket.meaning: Equivalence is proved by two convergent shuffles; neither vanishing conjecture is proved. This is established source material, not a new result of the present report.

restricted_presentation_obstruction.statement: The existing weight-seven separating functional takes value 485683200 on the frozen integer-normalized candidate, so the restricted single-product presentation alone cannot prove it.
restricted_presentation_obstruction.meaning: A limitation of that proof presentation; not a proof that the numerical identity is false or that the constants are arithmetically independent.

latest_certified_proximity.statement: Exact rational proximity schemes give absolute residuals below 10^-355 for the normalized S6 and current S8 equations. Both intervals contain zero.
latest_certified_proximity.audit_action: Source status and formulas were read at the pinned commit; this audit did not rerun those separate historical proximity certificates.

distinct_rejected_older_S8_vector.warning: This exclusion concerns a different basket and vector. It does not refute the current odd-inner-index S8 conjecture, all relations in the old basket, or period dependence.

applicability_of_present_results.harmonic_closure: The new Gamma-ratio theorem sums uncolored E_{n,r}/(n+a)^s. The source T_{p,r}(a) has an additional (-1)^n. The substitution a=1/2 alone therefore does not cover S6 or S8; g_{a,b} further involves H_{2n}^{(b)}, not the same elementary harmonic coefficient.
applicability_of_present_results.bilinear_and_dilation_closure: The exact finite-part correlations and affine transfer formulas do not identify either frozen Gaussian residual with zero. Their coefficient identities are not a proof of the fixed-weight conjectures.
applicability_of_present_results.trilinear_colored_Tornheim_coordinates: At rational shifts the new formula gives root-of-unity colored Tornheim order jets, and at positive integer inner orders partial fractions give Gaussian multiple-polylogarithm values. These are useful coordinate representations, but no new exact relation has been proved that annihilates either frozen residual. Discrete-index partial-fraction identities cannot simply be differentiated in their integer indices.
applicability_of_present_results.concrete_remaining_task: Find and prove the missing weight-seven and weight-nine mixed-endpoint functional relations, then reduce them exactly to the frozen baskets. For S6 the existing separating functional supplies a diagnostic that the argument has gone beyond the insufficient restricted product presentation.
applicability_of_present_results.independence_claim: No numerical or arithmetic independence assertion is made.
